title: Prompts (structured per-shot prompts)
description: Structured per-shot prompts derived from first/last frames: decomposed into subject/action/camera/scene/lighting/style facets, plus a ready-to-use prompt_text. Producer: html/gen_prompts_html.py (planned); current producer shape observed in output/《小江湖》第03话…/prompts.json.

shot_id.description: Matches the id field in shots.json.

subject.description: Who/what is in the shot (characters, key objects).

camera.description: Framing and camera movement (shot scale, pan/tilt, etc.).

prompt_text.description: Ready-to-use prompt text (composed from the above facets).
